mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.7% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening housing market conditions that reduce consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 110) combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) indicate supply chain constraints and cost-push inflation that reduce corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers delayed Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average indicates strong household wealth effects that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a rapidly deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 indicates manufacturing output contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
